title: Respect browser, account and staff consent in analytics collection

source.ref: Owner analytics dashboard and user-flow request, 2026-11-13.

detail: Consenting browser activity is collected only after trusted audience resolution; client-supplied GA identity and authority flags cannot bypass the public collector. Identity comes from browser cookies, and private URL/title content is removed. New focused regressions failed before implementation; existing probes were preserved. Implementation proof does not assert production activation.
